technology_name: MicroGrid for Remote Villages-Rural Microgrid Power Supply System
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Lack of reliable electricity in remote rural regions
description: This microgrid system integrates distributed energy resources and loads to provide localized power generation and distribution. The technology is intended to deliver reliable electricity to rural areas where conventional grid connectivity is challenging.
applications:
Rural electrification and decentralized energy projects
Renewable energy developers and microgrid solution providers
Government agencies implementing village electrification programs
NGOs and development organizations working in remote communities
Industrial campuses, islands, and off-grid facilities requiring reliable localized power systems
